title: Can You Make Your Eyes SHAKE on Purpose? 👀
description:
Try it: shake your eyes side to side, fast. Can't? Your eyes only move in quick jumps, and between jumps your brain holds them still, like a parking brake. Cross them a little and try again. About 1 in 12 people can do it (one study found 8% of college students could): scientists think they let go of that brake, and their eyes flutter back and forth about 15 times a second (voluntary nystagmus). It's harmless and only lasts a few seconds. Eyes that shake on their own, without trying, are something for a doctor to check. It often runs in families. Could you shake them? Yes or no?
